C1419.title: MIT Brothers Charged in $25M MEV Exploit Lasting 12 Seconds
C1419.summary: On May 15, 2024, the U.S. Department of Justice announced charges against brothers Anton and James Peraire-Bueno. Prosecutors alleged that, after months of planning, they manipulated Ethereum's block-building process, induced trading bots to reveal transaction contents, obtained about $25 million in cryptocurrency within roughly 12 seconds, and then attempted to conceal and launder the proceeds.
